nodes.norm_label: localized copyable generation prompt with subject slot — implemented

nodes.label: MemoryStorage input FSM with metadata-only uploads — implemented
nodes.norm_label: memorystorage input fsm with metadata-only uploads — implemented
nodes.rationale: Selection state is ephemeral across restart, while prepared media and paid work are durable; raw image bytes are not kept in FSM or logs.

nodes.label: Turkish, English and German interfaces — implemented
nodes.norm_label: turkish, english and german interfaces — implemented
nodes.rationale: Initial Telegram language sets the locale; unsupported languages fall back to Turkish; manual choices persist.

nodes.label: Branded Telegram emoji and sticker set creation — implemented
nodes.norm_label: branded telegram emoji and sticker set creation — implemented
nodes.rationale: Titles end in ' • by @bot_username', slugs end in '_by_bot_username', and URLs match the chosen output type.

nodes.label: Durable successful-payment inbox — implemented
nodes.rationale: Persist updates before advancing Telegram polling offset, then replay unrecorded payments independent of FSM state.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL asyncpg support — deployment smoke tests outstanding
nodes.norm_label: postgresql asyncpg support — deployment smoke tests outstanding

nodes.label: Studio regular sticker output — implemented, 512×512 PNG
nodes.norm_label: studio regular sticker output — implemented, 512×512 png

nodes.label: Temporary SQLite and simulated Telegram validation — implemented tests
nodes.norm_label: temporary sqlite and simulated telegram validation — implemented tests
nodes.rationale: Coverage includes quotas, recovery, invoices, duplicate charges, nine blueprints, 81-tile regular sets, localized prompts, stale buttons and legacy migration.

nodes.label: Center-cropped row-major sprite slicing — implemented
nodes.rationale: Existing alpha is preserved and white backgrounds remain white. Direct emoji output uses lossless 100×100 WebP.

nodes.label: Idempotent 1.1 free_ai_studio_credits migration — implemented
nodes.rationale: Existing users get one Studio credit once; previous quotas, language, jobs and payments persist. create_all alone cannot add columns.

nodes.label: Commercial product ideas — proposals only, unvalidated
nodes.norm_label: commercial product ideas — proposals only, unvalidated
nodes.rationale: Records discussion, not authorization to implement, launch, spend, deploy, or send external messages. Demand, pricing, costs and returns are unvalidated.

nodes.label: Capped generation and correction rights — proposed cost control
nodes.norm_label: capped generation and correction rights — proposed cost control
nodes.rationale: Limit variable AI costs; unlimited AI generation is not the proposed launch model.

nodes.label: Personalization, consistent design and batch production as reasons to pay — unvalidated hypothesis
nodes.norm_label: personalization, consistent design and batch production as reasons to pay — unvalidated hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Telegram already offers creation and background removal; proposed differentiation needs a paid pilot.

nodes.label: Contribution per order from net payout minus variable and allocated costs — proposed assessment
nodes.norm_label: contribution per order from net payout minus variable and allocated costs — proposed assessment
nodes.rationale: Deduct AI generation/retries, server allocation, support, acquisition and refunds from actual net payout. Assess total profit separately including fixed costs and taxes; assume no exchange rate or margin.

nodes.label: Stars purchase price differs from seller net cash revenue — accounting constraint
nodes.norm_label: stars purchase price differs from seller net cash revenue — accounting constraint
nodes.rationale: Do not treat the user's Stars purchase price as the seller's cash revenue or assume exact conversion rates.

nodes.label: At-least-once result delivery — explicit current limitation
nodes.norm_label: at-least-once result delivery — explicit current limitation
nodes.rationale: Telegram sendDocument/sendMessage lack an idempotency key; crashes before local completion commits can redeliver an already sent result, despite idempotent payments and quota accounting.

nodes.label: Atomic quota reservation and job insertion — implemented
nodes.norm_label: atomic quota reservation and job insertion — implemented
nodes.rationale: One database transaction reserves credit and creates the job. Invalid images and no-face inputs do not reserve credit or generate invoices.

nodes.label: Studio format buttons bound to the uploaded image — implemented
nodes.norm_label: studio format buttons bound to the uploaded image — implemented
nodes.rationale: Old buttons cannot submit a replacement image.

nodes.label: Worker threads with bounded image processing pool — implemented
nodes.norm_label: worker threads with bounded image processing pool — implemented
nodes.rationale: Drawing and slicing share bounded CPU slots; upload/pixel limits constrain decoded memory. Blueprints stream from memory.

nodes.label: Restart recovery for prepared jobs, assets and refunds — implemented
nodes.norm_label: restart recovery for prepared jobs, assets and refunds — implemented
nodes.rationale: Persist job state, sticker file IDs, deterministic pack names and pending refunds so unfinished work survives process restart.

nodes.label: Prepared-media expiry, cleanup and retained support records — implemented
nodes.norm_label: prepared-media expiry, cleanup and retained support records — implemented
nodes.rationale: Prepared media are deleted after success/failure or expiry; approved invoices retain media an extra 24 hours for delayed payments. Metadata and receipts remain for support; Telegram retains uploaded copies.

nodes.label: Unique-charge payment and quota idempotency — implemented
nodes.norm_label: unique-charge payment and quota idempotency — implemented
nodes.rationale: Repeat payment updates do not repeat completed operations or consume more quota; additional charges for one job are refunded.

nodes.label: 512 KiB PNG upload budget with palette reduction — implemented
nodes.norm_label: 512 kib png upload budget with palette reduction — implemented
nodes.rationale: Oversized Studio PNG tiles use a palette with transparent colors to fit static-sticker upload limits.

nodes.label: Network retries, rate-limit scheduling and persistent refunds — implemented
nodes.norm_label: network retries, rate-limit scheduling and persistent refunds — implemented
nodes.rationale: Network/server errors retry three times after the initial attempt; retry_after governs rate limits. Permanent failures restore free credit or queue a Stars refund, whose failures retry durably.

nodes.label: Three independent service quota pools — implemented
nodes.norm_label: three independent service quota pools — implemented
nodes.rationale: Direct emoji, face censorship and Studio cannot consume each other's free allowance.

nodes.label: Single-instance polling deployment with filesystem lock — implemented
nodes.norm_label: single-instance polling deployment with filesystem lock — implemented
nodes.rationale: One process per token/data directory. Scaling to multiple instances needs distributed leases, shared media and a shared FSM.

nodes.label: 50 initial stickers then append remaining tiles — implemented
nodes.norm_label: 50 initial stickers then append remaining tiles — implemented
nodes.rationale: Telegram limits initial set creation to 50 entries. The 81-tile Studio flow appends 31; the 64-tile direct flow appends 14. Identical stickers may be merged by Telegram.

nodes.label: Non-accumulating UTC daily photo credit — implemented
nodes.norm_label: non-accumulating utc daily photo credit — implemented
nodes.rationale: Reset lazily on first interaction after 00:00 UTC and consume daily credit before lifetime credit. A previous day's failed reservation cannot add an extra current-day credit.
